mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id, m.name AS member_name, w.work_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM round_seat rs WHERE rs.reservation_id = r.reservation_id) AS seat_count, r.total_paid, r.regdate FROM reservation r JOIN member m ON r.member_id = m.member_id JOIN round rd ON r.round_id = rd.round_id JOIN work w ON rd.work_id = w.work_id ORDER BY r.regdate DESC
